rollback_evidence: Measured on vJunos-switch 26.2R1.7 (ELS, model ex9214; GNS3 lab, task netops-provoz-20261116-308, ref/mereni-c8) and repeated end to end through Admin in task netops-20261116-319. Safeguard first: Admin commits an empty 'commit confirmed 10 comment "netops-<id>"' in configure exclusive (configure private refuses commit confirmed) and verifies its row 'rollback pending' in show system commit. The change runs line by line in an interactive session: configure exclusive, an empty candidate (show | compare), the set and delete lines, show | compare and 'commit confirmed 10 comment "netops-change"', which restarts the timer from the change commit; an expiry then rolls back the change as well (measured). Admin never sends commit check, and it never commits the change or the inverse lines of an immediate return with a plain commit during the pending timer, because a plain commit and commit check both confirm it (commit check without any trace in the commit history or the log); both use commit confirmed. The only plain commit during the pending timer is the confirmation of the proven own timer: 'commit comment "netops-<id>-ok"'; the row 'rollback pending' must then be gone. It is sent after the readback of the change with at least confirm_margin_seconds left, or as the end of an immediate return (started with at least 240 s of the timer left): at once when no change commit exists yet (a snapshot then checks the state before), otherwise after the inverse commit confirmed and a snapshot proving the state before. The timer counts whole minutes and expired 0-60 s after them; the automatic rollback is committed as 'root via other' 55-112 s later, which is the proof Admin waits for; a confirmation that starts before the expiry won the measured race (the log reported 'automatic rollback failed as other commit triggered during rollback'). A commit took 15-150 s on the loaded lab, so Admin uses 10 minutes and a confirmation margin of at least 240 s. A commit is the saved configuration. The expiry returns the whole configuration to the state before the change commit, so a commit of someone else in the timer window is returned too. The timer across a reload is not measured. The write account needs the permissions configure, view and view-configuration (the lab uses class super-user); the check account (class read-only) reads show interfaces <if> terse, show interfaces descriptions and show ethernet-switching interface <if>; it cannot read the configuration. Junos accepts the configuration of a missing interface, so the interface must be listed by show interfaces <if> terse; management interfaces (fxp, em, me, vme) are refused. Access VLAN by name of an access port (unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode access) only: 'delete interfaces <if> unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members' and 'set interfaces <if> unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members NAME' ('set ... vlan members' adds a member, it does not replace one). The VLAN must exist: show vlans NAME is empty for a missing VLAN, and Junos refuses a missing VLAN name only at commit time. A trunk, a LAG member or a routed port is refused.
